text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. didn't show up for training. Worried, I was searching the school grounds when a colleague called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Your training plan really was incredible!
I could totally tell you shaved off sleep to put it together.
choice_data_list: I'm still figuring it out through trial and error, though.
I'm still figuring it out through trial and error, though.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
With this, my trainee should—speak of the devil.
I hope she likes the menu. See ya!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
choice_data_list: Good, you seem to be doing well.
Good, you seem to be doing well.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sorry about that.
I just really wasn't in the mood for training.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I was just killing time, and ended up slacking off completely.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So, I overheard a bit earlier.
...You came up with a new menu for me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I'll definitely show up to the next training session.
I'm really curious to see what the menu will be, after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Free-spirited as she was, she seemed to regret her actions, so I settled for simply cautioning her to be careful in the future.
